name: server-add
title: Adding a server
alt: zekno server add prod-1 over SSH: it installs the runner at ~/.local/bin/zekno-runner after the file matched the checksum this zekno holds, connects prod-1 and adds it to the team list, shows the server code, and says that the server's identity rests on SSH's host verification.

fixed.what: the server code, made from the key the runner creates on each run

lines: Installed the runner 0.1.1 at ~/.local/bin/zekno-runner. It matched the checksum this zekno holds.
Connected "prod-1" and added it to the team list.
You reached this server over SSH, so its identity rests on SSH's host verification.
